tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: The rematch at the Garden, four days after the Knicks beat Cleveland 109-97 — Brunson had 31 points and 9 assists, Towns 29 and 13. The Cavs have leaked since: Charlotte hit 23 threes and won the glass 49-32 against them on Monday. The Knicks have won four straight and rolled Milwaukee 117-85 on Tuesday (Towns 21 and 16, Anunoby 19). No price on the side clears our 0.75% bar — the only number beating fair anywhere in this game is Cleveland's moneyline (+172 offshore vs a 37.0% fair, +0.6% EV), so this is a lean, not a board play. The board play in this game is the prop: OG Anunoby Under 2.5 threes at -150 (BetMGM), +2.5% EV vs the devigged FanDuel fair. No true edge on the side, but the lean is Cleveland +4: the only price in the game that beats fair, and the Cavs were in this same matchup four days ago.
games.title: Cavaliers at Knicks: the rematch at the Garden
games.venue: Madison Square Garden, New York, NY
games.verdict: LEAN: CLE +4 — no true edge, but Cleveland's moneyline is the closest thing to value in the game.

games.take: The Lakers are on the board tonight: -659 at Lowvig is +0.8% EV against the devigged Pinnacle fair of 87.5%, while Pinnacle itself is -779. Austin Reaves is back from illness after missing Monday's win over Atlanta; LeBron remains out with sciatica and the price already reflects that. The moneyline is the whole case — a favorite this big pays nothing to lay, but the number is the number. Thin edge, labeled honestly.
games.title: Lakers at Bucks: the -659 favorite
games.verdict: LEAN: LAL — on the board at -659 (Lowvig), +0.8% EV vs the devigged Pinnacle fair.

games.take: The Spurs are on the board tonight: -14.5 at -105 (ESPN Bet) is +0.9% EV against the devigged Pinnacle fair of 51.7% on the spread, while Pinnacle is -112. San Antonio just beat Phoenix by 26 on Monday and is the far better team; the injury flags cut both ways — Vassell (groin) is questionable for the Spurs, Powell (back) is questionable for the Bulls. Thin edge, labeled honestly.
games.title: Spurs at Bulls: laying 14.5 on the road
games.verdict: LEAN: SAS -14.5 — on the board at -105 (ESPN Bet), +0.9% EV vs the devigged Pinnacle fair.

games.matchup: Oklahoma City Thunder @ Portland Trail Blazers
games.our_fair: Thunder 50.7% / Trail Blazers 49.3% (devigged Pinnacle fair, moneyline)
games.take: Portland beat OKC 123-103 in this same building last night — Lillard 25, Avdija 24 and 8 assists, Holiday 11 off the bench — and the line barely moved: the Thunder are still a 1-point favorite and the fair line is a 50.7/49.3 coin flip. The board play in this game is the prop: Jrue Holiday Over 4.5 assists at +120 (BetMGM), +6.5% EV vs the devigged FanDuel fair — FanDuel is -108. No true edge on the side, but the lean is Portland +1: they just beat this same Thunder team by 20 at home and the market hasn't adjusted.
games.title: Thunder at Trail Blazers: the rematch in Portland
games.verdict: LEAN: POR +1 — no true edge, but the Blazers just beat OKC by 20 in this building last night.

games.take: Both teams are 8-3, both rank top five in net rating, and this is their first meeting of the season — the ESPN nightcap. Golden State rides an eight-game win streak with Curry averaging 30.6 a night, but arrives shorthanded: Butler, Moody and Porzingis are out, Gary Payton II is out, and Will Richard is questionable with a torn thumb ligament, opening a five-game road trip. Houston is without both backup centers (Adams, Capela), leaving Sengun as the only true center, but the starting five of VanVleet, Thompson, Durant, Smith and Sengun is plus-7.5 per 94 minutes together. No price clears our bar. No true edge, but the lean is Houston -6: the healthier, home side with the better five.
games.title: Warriors at Rockets: 8-3 vs 8-3 on ESPN
games.verdict: LEAN: HOU -6 — no true edge, but the Rockets are the healthier home side.

games.take: Buffalo is 6-3, 4-1 in the MAC, riding a four-game win streak and right in the title chase; QB Jason Wright threw for a career-high 358 yards last week at Miami (OH), and RB Messiah Burch leads the MAC with 901 rushing yards. Ball State is 3-6 but 5-1 all-time at home against Buffalo and is coming off an overtime loss at UMass. Light rain and high-40s temperatures at kickoff with gusty north winds in Muncie — no NWS alerts — which favors Buffalo's ground game against a Cardinals run defense allowing 179.8 yards a game. No true edge, but the lean is Buffalo -1: the better team, the better run game, in weather that suits it.
games.title: Buffalo at Ball State: MACtion in the rain
games.verdict: LEAN: BUF -1 — no true edge, but the Bulls' ground game fits a rainy night in Muncie.
games.weather: Light rain, high 40s at kickoff, north wind 10-15 mph with gusts to 30 mph — no NWS alerts
